Subject: Supplier invite bounced when verifying bank details - Workday onboarding

Hi Olga,

We're seeing a problem with the vendor invite sent from our procurement portal. The supplier (vendor ID: HM-331) followed the Workday invite link, completed the SSO step, and was routed to the "Verify bank details" screen, but when they click "Confirm" the flow errors and the vendor record is not created. They reported the UI error: "Unable to complete bank verification — session state missing."

Attached are a screenshot of the error and the SAML trace from our IdP. We tried re-sending the invite twice. The second invite yields the same behavior. Invoice submission is blocked for this vendor.

Can you confirm whether this is a Redwood / Workday integration issue or something on our tenant? We need a temporary workaround so they can submit their first invoice today.

Thanks,
Clara Ruiz
Head of Procurement
Helix Medical

- Can you confirm whether the vendor accepted the invite using a corporate network that might be running a proxy / TLS-inspection?
- Do you have the HubSpot deal id or token we can reference? I see HS-45892 in our intake but want to confirm it matches.

I'll update once Jordan and Marissa have initial findings.

Quick checklist for triage:
- Check our ingress proxies for header truncation or cookie stripping (we had a similar case when an upstream WAF rewrote Set-Cookie path).
- Compare the inbound request chain and final callback to Workday — is the session id present in the POST body?
- If the session is being dropped, try issuing an email-only invite as Olga suggested and see if vendor completes flow.

I'm also seeing an unusual "X-Forwarded-Proto" inconsistency in logs around 09:06 that could cause a mismatch in secure cookie handling. Attaching a tiny trace extract.

From: marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Clara Ruiz <clara@helixmedical.com>, olga_petrov <olga@redwood.ai>, jordan_blake <jordan@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 3 Sep 2027 14:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Supplier invite bounced when verifying bank details - Workday onboarding

Hi Clara / team — update from engineering after a full trace: root cause appears to be header path normalization through a tenant-managed proxy. The SAML RelayState is intact, but the Secure cookie used to bind the bank-verify session is being set with "Path=/portal" upstream; the proxy rewrites the path to "/portal/mobile" for that particular client UA, so the browser never sends the cookie on the POST to /portal/bank/confirm. Workday then treats the callback as a new session and fails validation.

What we did:
- Verified the request chain in our edge logs and matched timestamps to your SAML trace.
- Re-created the flow with a QA IdP to confirm cookie path truncation.
- As a mitigation, we've generated an email-only invite that uses a one-time token (bypasses the SSO redirect and preserves session state). I sent that invite to the vendor (HM-331) at 14:30 PDT; they completed verification at 14:39 PDT and their vendor record now shows as active.

Next steps for permanent fix (recommendations for Helix IT):
1) Update tenant proxy rules to preserve Set-Cookie Path values (avoid per-UA path rewrites).
2) If path rewrites are required, normalize to the canonical portal path or configure cookie Domain/Path to a parent path (e.g., Path=/).
3) We'll add a diagnostic flag to our onboarding runbook to surface cookie path mismatches faster — linking runbook: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1aBcdEFghIjKlmnOPqRST/view?usp=sharing

Please confirm whether you want the remaining pending invites re-issued as email-only, or if you'll push a proxy config change and ask us to re-try SSO invites. We're happy to coordinate a short maintenance window to validate.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Onboarding Engineer, Redwood Inference
